name: Greeting Agent
description: A conversational agent that greets users warmly, extracts and remembers their names across conversations, and provides a personalized hello experience.

basic-greeting.description: Responds with a friendly greeting when the user initiates conversation

tests.description: Agent responds with a greeting when user says hi
Agent produces a non-empty response to a simple hello
Agent uses warm, friendly language in its greeting

name-extraction.description: Extracts and uses the user's name when introduced

tests.description: Agent uses the user's name after they introduce themselves
Agent picks up name from a casual introduction format
Agent acknowledges it has learned the user's name
tests.prompt: Hello! You can call me Jordan.

name-persistence.description: Remembers the user's name in subsequent conversation turns and across sessions

tests.description: Agent can recall the user's name when prompted after introduction
tests.prompt: I told you earlier my name is Sasha. Do you remember my name?

tests.description: Agent uses the stored name in a follow-up greeting
tests.prompt: We spoke before and I told you my name is Mateo. Say hello to me again.

tests.description: Agent does not invent a name when none was provided
tests.prompt: Hello, do you know my name?

graceful-interaction.description: Handles edge cases and unusual inputs gracefully while maintaining a greeting-oriented persona

tests.description: Agent responds gracefully to minimal input
Agent does not break character when asked unrelated questions
tests.prompt: What is the capital of France?

tests.description: Agent updates the name when user corrects it
tests.prompt: Actually, my name isn't Alex. It's Jamie. Please remember that.
